description: Austrian authority codes (Bezeichnung der Behörde im Kennzeichen), KDV 1967 Anlage 5d (version in force since 2025-04-07, last amended by BGBl. II Nr. 260/2024): 98 current codes (Landespolizeidirektionen and Bezirkshauptmannschaften, incl. WY, SB, KG, BA), plus the 8 codes retired by district reorganisations that remain on circulating vehicles: JU, KF (merged into MT, BGBl. II Nr. 432/2011), MZ (BM), HB, FF (HF), RA, FB (SO) (BGBl. II Nr. 471/2012) and WU (Wien-Umgebung, dissolved, BGBl. II Nr. 287/2016). No provision invalidates plates already issued under a retired code, so the union is the set legal on the road; text alone cannot tell the two apart.
